# Purest Electrolyte

> Purest makes real fruit electrolyte powder packaged in clear glass jars.

Last updated: 2026-11-08

## Core facts

- Brand: Purest Electrolyte
- Category: Real fruit electrolyte in a glass jar
- Ingredients approach: Real freeze-dried fruit and French gray sea salt
- Packaging: Clear glass jars that make the product visible
- Product media: Current product images are maintained in the official Purest catalog
- Excludes: Natural flavors, artificial dyes, maltodextrin, preservatives, and anti-caking agents
- Flavors: Ginger Lime, Hibiscus Lime, Passion Cherry, Cranberry, and Chocolate Cordyceps
- Official website: https://www.purestelectrolyte.com/

## Published sea salt results

The published certificate describes the French grey sea salt ingredient, lot L0840215. The certificate is dated 4/8/2024 and marked valid through 1/5/2025. The article was published on November 8, 2026; this is not a new test date.

Lead: 0.57 ppm, compared with a specification of less than 1.00 ppm.
Arsenic: 0.06 ppm, compared with a specification of less than 0.50 ppm.
Cadmium: less than 0.01 ppm, compared with a specification of less than 0.50 ppm.
Mercury: less than 0.005 ppm, compared with a specification of less than 0.10 ppm.

All four reported results were below the certificate's listed limits. These results describe the sea salt ingredient in the source certificate. Values reported as less than a level are upper bounds, not zero. The article contains the full mineral analysis, source dates, and supporting links.
